correctness.rationale: For all n≥1, two explicit (n+1)-square positive kernels H±M give the cb upper bound t=(5n-1)/(3n+1); n−1 leaf-difference eigenvalues and two zero 2x2 determinants prove positivity. A normalized vector with center weight (n+1)/(3n+1) and each leaf weight 2/(3n+1) gives a trace-norm t lower witness via the sign of its compressed mask. For countably many leaves, explicit completely positive kernels of diagonal weights 4/3 and 1/3 give cb≤5/3, and finite corners yield ≥5/3. Exact finite tests corroborate but do not replace the proof.
